title: 2022年6月 第3套
passage: 赵州桥建于隋朝，公元605年左右，长50.82米，宽9.6米，跨度37.37米。天才建筑师李春设计并监督了桥的建设。赵州桥结构新颖、造型优美。桥有一个大拱，在大拱的两端有两个小拱，帮助排泄洪水、减轻桥梁重量并节省石材。建成以来，该桥经受了多次洪水和地震，但其主体结构仍然完好无损，至今仍在使用。赵州桥是世界桥梁建筑史上的一次创举，是中国古代文明史上的一项杰出成就。类似设计的桥梁直到14世纪才在欧洲出现，比赵州桥晚了700多年。
reference: The Zhaozhou Bridge, which was constructed in the Sui Dynasty around 605 AD, is 50.82 meters long, 9.6 meters wide with a span of 37.37 meters. Li Chun, a genius architect, designed and supervised its construction. The Zhaozhou Bridge features a novel structure and graceful shape. The bridge has a main arch with two minor arches on its ends to help release floodwater, reduce the total weight of the bridge and save the stone. Since its completion, the bridge has stood the tests of numerous floods and earthquakes, but its main structure remains intact and still in use today. The Zhaozhou Bridge is a pioneering undertaking in the history of world bridge construction, and an outstanding achievement in the history of the Chinese ancient civilization. Bridges with similar design did not appear in Europe until the 14th century, 700 years later than the Zhaozhou Bridge.
notes: reduce the weight of the bridge
points: 第一句：主干用 which 引导的非限制性定语从句交代建造年代，主句说明桥的尺寸；“长50.82米，宽9.6米，跨度37.37米”用 is 50.82 meters long, 9.6 meters wide with a span of 37.37 meters。
第二句：同位语 a genius architect 紧跟在 Li Chun 之后；“设计并监督了桥的建设”用 designed and supervised its construction 顺译。
第三句：“结构新颖、造型优美”用 features a novel structure and a graceful shape，也可用 boast 替代 features。
第四句：主干 The bridge has a main arch；“在大拱的两端有两个小拱”用 with two minor arches on its ends 作后置定语；“帮助排泄洪水、减轻重量并节省石材”用不定式 to help release..., reduce... and save... 表用途。
第五句：“建成以来”用 since 引导时间状语，主句用现在完成时 has stood the tests of；“但其主体结构仍然完好无损，至今仍在使用”用 but 连接，remains intact and still in use today。
第六句：两个表语“一次创举、一项杰出成就”用 and 并列，译作 a pioneering undertaking... and an outstanding achievement...，注意冠词。
第七句：“直到……才……”用 not... until 结构；“比赵州桥晚了700多年”用 700 years later than... 作比较状语。
